game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle, a saddle between peaks: the mountaineer must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Cipher Decoder: Shift characters using ord/chr operations to decode secret notes.
theme: Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle: a saddle between peaks
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Saddle, repeat each round: Shift characters using ord/chr operations to decode secret notes. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the decoded value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the pass gate using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The pass gate reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the pass gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 1 (intro tier): Cipher Decoder
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Cipher Decoder' (Week 8 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Blizzard Saddle'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how decoded changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Blizzard Saddle.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The pass gate reached with actions_used <= 14.
